_comment: Curated brand -> {strain variant: canonical spelling}. Collapses spelling drift so the same strain lands on one value across every dispensary — the enrichment prompt's 'keep the source spelling' rule prevents hallucination but cannot make two dispensaries agree, so that job belongs here. Matching is case-insensitive. A canonical value of "" clears the strain. Keys starting with _ are ignored; the key "*" applies to every brand. Populate from the `strain_split` findings of `python evals/enrich/audit.py --db`.
